verses.text: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
lines: My soul rests in God alone.
My salvation is from him.

verses.text: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
lines: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress.
I will never be greatly shaken.

verses.text: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
lines: How long will you assault a man?
Would all of you throw him down,
like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

verses.text: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly.
lines: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place.
They delight in lies.
They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly.

verses.text: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
lines: My soul, wait in silence for God alone,
for my expectation is from him.

verses.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
lines: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress.
I will not be shaken.

verses.text: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
lines: My salvation and my honor is with God.
The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

verses.text: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
lines: Trust in him at all times, you people.
Pour out your heart before him.
God is a refuge for us.

verses.text: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
lines: Surely men of low degree are just a breath,
and men of high degree are a lie.
In the balances they will go up.
They are together lighter than a breath.

verses.text: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
lines: Don’t trust in oppression.
Don’t become vain in robbery.
If riches increase,
don’t set your heart on them.

verses.text: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
lines: God has spoken once;
twice I have heard this,
that power belongs to God.

verses.text: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
lines: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness,
for you reward every man according to his work.
